mentioned.quote: Cyber: Risks of models assisting in the development, preparation, and/or execution of a cyber attack.

threshold.quote: Cyber uplift level 1: Provides sufficient uplift with high impact cyber attacks for additional expected harm at severe scale.

response.quote: external deployments of a model take place only after the appropriate governance function determines the safety case regarding each CCL the model has reached to be adequate.
response.note: Gate on deployment until safety case adequate (E3); p.6-7 acceptance criteria are 'if, for example', security levels only 'recommended'.

acc_decider.note: Only 'the appropriate governance function' (p.9, p.12) and 'appropriate corporate governance bodies' (p.16) are named, with no specific role or body.

acc_external.quote: When a model reaches an alert threshold for a CCL, we will assess the proximity of the model to the CCL and analyze the risk posed, involving internal and external experts as needed.
acc_external.note: Ambiguous: 'as needed' read as not voiding per E2; external experts inform the threshold analysis. 'Where appropriate, we may engage ... external actors' (p.5) is hedged; p.16 disclosure to government is sharing only.

acc_unmet.note: p.9 and p.12 deployment gate turns on the safety case being adequate (risk acceptable), which is E4 gate-only; p.16 adherence assessment leads to framework updates, not a non-compliance procedure; p.7 security 'or we otherwise assess' escape.
